summary.text: Delores Oates is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 31, which covers Clarke County and parts of Frederick and Warren counties.
Delores Oates has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Delores Oates was born in Front Royal, Virginia.
Delores Oates studied at Regent University (B.A., Government, 2017) and Lord Fairfax Community College (A.A.&S., General Studies, 1986).
Delores Oates's listed occupation is vice president of sales and delivery.
Delores Oates's listed memberships and affiliations include Young Lives (leader, 2017-2019).
The profile lists Rob A. Oates as Delores Oates's spouse.
The House profile lists Delores Oates's committee assignments as Public Safety and Communications, Technology and Innovation.
